text:
elaine-d: quick thread  we need a clear policy on fetch/polyfills for the JS SDK. two pain points: bundlers accidentally pulling node polyfills into edge bundles, and TS consumers hitting RequestInit issues. thoughts?

sam-eng: prefer runtime-detect + explicit opt-in for undici. no implicit installs. main goal: zero surprise for edge apps.

mike-sdk: +1. also suggest we expose which fetch implementation was picked in debug logs (e.g., DEBUG=redwood:sdk -> prints "fetch=global" or "fetch=undici"). helps users debug polyfill/bundle problems.

erika: small nuance: pnpm + hoisting can still make optionalDependency available even if user didn't mean to install it. we should document how to ensure edge-only projects don't bring in undici (pnpm overrides, bundler externals).

sam-eng: good point. docs should include concrete pnpm/webpack/next.config examples to avoid bundling undici.

ria-docs: TS fix: instead of referencing DOM types directly, ship a tiny fetch-types.d.ts with export type FetchLike = (input: any, init?: any) => Promise<any>; export the type from our package so users who want strict DOM types opt into lib:
{ "compilerOptions": { "lib": ["ES2020","DOM"] }}

mike-sdk: runtime API idea: getFetchSync() -> returns fetch or null; ensureFetch() -> Promise<fetch>. for require() users getFetchSync is enough to fail loudly and show install steps. keep code path tiny and dynamic import undici only in ensureFetch.

sam-eng: also implement a normalizeBody util so SDK accepts string/Buffer/ReadableStream/AsyncIterator/ArrayBuffer and converts to a single body type for server transports. avoids cross-runtime differences with streaming.

elaine-d: tests: CI matrix must include Node(no-undici), Node(with undici installed), Bun, and a Workers binary (miniflare). run small smoke test verifying SDK logs which fetch impl and that retries behave identically.

ci-bot: noted. Please add matrix entries and a unit test that asserts debug log contains fetch=global or fetch=undici and that Request bodies are normalized.

ria-docs: docs checklist I'll add: 1) Quickstart snippets for Node vs Edge 2) How to fix TS errors 3) pnpm/webpack/Next.js examples 4) Troubleshooting section w/ debug log examples.

mike-sdk: final question: optionalDependency vs documenting install? I lean to documenting install (no dep) so edge users never get it by accident. call A: no undici in package.json, runtime-detect + docs.

sam-eng: OK final decision A. I'll draft PR with getFetchSync/ensureFetch, normalizeBody, minimal fetch-types, debug logs and CI matrix. will tag reviewers.
